recentItems.title: Murder in Galicia | Official Teaser | Netflix
recentItems.description:
The Galician town of Pazos is caught up in a wave of home burglaries, but alarm bells start ringing when Irene, one of the residents, suffers a brutal attack in her own home. While she fights for her life in the hospital, Elías, a Civil Guard sergeant, is convinced that Aniceto, the victim’s husband, is behind the crime. No one seems willing to listen to his evidence, while the suspect remains at large and Irene’s life hangs in the balance.

Tristán Ulloa and Miguel Borines lead the cast, which also includes Carlos Blanco, Fer Fraga, Verónica Sánchez, Fernando Guillén Cuervo, Nacho Fresneda, and Tito Asorey, among others.

Murder in Galicia is executive produced by Ramón Campos. Directed by Carlos Sedes, with a screenplay by Ramón Campos himself, David Orea, Curro Serrano, and Gema R. Neira, and with Carlos Garcés serving as director of photography.

recentItems.title: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild | Official Teaser | Netflix
recentItems.description:
When the open-source AI platform Hugging Face was hit by a cyberattack this July, it quickly became clear this was no ordinary breach because the hackers weren’t human: they were autonomous agents created by OpenAI researchers.

Instadocs: AI Gone Wild reconstructs the breach as it’s never been seen before and treats the incident as what it may be: our clearest warning shot yet about AI’s unintended capabilities — sparking dire concerns about the future of the technology.

Instadocs: AI Gone Wild premieres October 12.

recentItems.title: Heartland | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
In this town, fame has a price.

Former country megastar, Misty Jones, comes out of seclusion to investigate the disappearance of her missing niece, a rising country musician, and must grapple with her own past and Nashville’s seedy underbelly. Her search uncovers a murky side of Nashville where no one, including Misty, is who they seem.

Jessica Chastain, Garrett Hedlund, Carter Faith, Ross Lynch, Paul Sparks, Jennifer Nettles and John Hawkes star in HEARTLAND, premiering November 13. The soundtrack drops the same day. Pre-save the album now: https://netflixmusic.ffm.to/heartland
